title.description: Full paper title. NOT the claim_under_test string. Reads like an ICML paper title: noun phrase, ideally <= 15 words.

running_title.description: Short title for headers / page running title.

mental_model_statement.description: The single good mental model this paper gives the reader, in 2-4 sentences. This text appears as a highlighted card immediately after the abstract. Operator language, not jargon.

section_outline.description: Ordered list of sections to write. ICML-style typical: introduction, related_work, background, method, experiments, discussion, conclusion. Each section will be submitted separately via submit_paper_section.

purpose.description: What this section does for the reader's mental model — not what topics it covers.

figure_refs.description: figure_ids registered via register_paper_figure that this section references.

figure_specs.description: Server-rendered figures the paper will use. Must register at least one — a Sakana-v2-style paper without figures is not a paper, it's a memo. Each item is also validated against paper_figure_request.schema by the handler.

data_source.description: Dot-path into the state bundle (e.g., 'worker_report.metrics', 'worker_report.baselines') or 'rebuttal_synthesis.*'.

abstract_seed.description: Draft abstract (will be refined in submit_paper_section for section_id='abstract'). 150-250 words, plain prose, no jargon dump.
